name: Remote Desktop Commander
description:
Reach your computer's filesystem and terminal from any Claude conversation. 
Desktop Commander's Remote MCP relays a secure connection to your real machine, giving Claude the same full file and shell access as the local server — without you needing to be at the keyboard. 

Build, explore, and automate from chat:
Build from scratch — Create features and applications with simple commands
Manage development environments — Set up servers, configure systems, and handle processes
Manage context and documentation — Keep track of project details and technical specifications
Explore existing codebases and projects — Navigate and understand complex repositories
Edit documents in place — Work on Word, Excel, and PDF files where they live on disk

This bridges technical skill gaps with full command-line superpowers, reachable from any Claude surface — web, mobile, or desktop — as long as the Desktop Commander app is running on the machine you want to drive.

Developed by Desktop Commander Team

_published_faq.name: How do I add Remote Desktop Commander to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Remote Desktop Commander to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.desktopcommander.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Remote Desktop Commander MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Remote Desktop Commander lists 30 MCP tools, including read_file, read_multiple_files, list_directory, get_file_info, start_search, get_more_search_results, stop_search, list_searches, write_file, edit_block, move_file, and create_directory.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Remote Desktop Commander?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Remote Desktop Commander in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Remote Desktop Commander MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Remote Desktop Commander requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Remote Desktop Commander is developed by Desktop Commander. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
